executive_summary: APPROVED (round 2; review ran 16:58-17:15 local). Every round-1 finding is remediated, proven with my own executions rather than the operator's evidence file; two non-blocking residual findings about gate ACTIVATION (not the shipped rendering) are recorded as minors. [Round-1 major, remediated] (1) The payload key-convention test fails when pinned to the iteration-02 quarterly-key payload: '1 failed in 0.12s', exit 1, AssertionError 'the Fed October 30-day futures average is monthly tenor; it must not be stored under a quarterly-named key'; pinned to the approved iteration-03 candidate it passes ('1 passed'). Full render file pinned to iteration-03: '9 passed', exit 0. (2) The card-region render test is genuinely region-scoped and sensitive: in a scratch clone outside the repo with the renderer hunk reverse-applied byte-exactly (control passes; byte-diff vs the frozen file is exactly the 6-to-3-line template block at index.html:1029-1033), it fails with 'the Fed card does not show the payload's monthly-average level 3.895%' and is the ONLY test that catches that reversion (full file on the reversed renderer: 1 failed, 8 passed). [Round-1 minors, remediated] (3) A mistyped pin now fails loudly: FED_BOC_RENDER_CANDIDATE=D:/nope/candidate.json gives '6 failed, 3 passed in 0.22s', exit 1, each render test failing with 'a mistyped pin must fail, not skip'; test_missing_pinned_candidate_fails_closed passes and exercises the raise. (4) The round-2 manifest created_at (2026-09-29T16:56:41-04:00) equals its file mtime (16:56:41.457) and predates the review launch (16:57:55), so it is not forward-dated. Subject integrity: all four digests and byte sizes verified before and after the review, unchanged throughout (index.html 8b1242a0..., tests/test_render_truthfulness.py fbcf6afc..., scripts/econ/frontend_contract.json 83c45f41..., fed-boc-watcher/BACKEND_DATA_SPEC.md 2d3729f7...; manifest befe53f5...); frontend-tenor.patch (sha256 d866855915bd814fa29a997ca60cf823bb14217c91d763a9c67e4c656810e8ee) is byte-identical to the HEAD-to-worktree diff of its three tracked files, and the LF-normalized index.html digest a128633d... still equals the frontend_contract.json fed-boc-watcher entry. Test batteries: full suite '84 passed, 3 skipped', exit 0 (the skips are the designed unpinned payload-predates-contract skips); node --test 19/19 pass; pinned render gate 9/9. Round-2 attacks, all clean for the frozen subject: in the raw dumped DOM the markers 'odds-card fed'/'odds-card boc' occur exactly once each (inside the card divs) and the earlier 'formula-fold' occurrences are all inside <style> before the cards, unreachable by the after-start search, so the region extraction slices exactly one card each (551/704 chars); the card level and label occur in-card only inside the proxy line's single <b> element (renderOdds :1033 rendered at :1042) — every duplicate is brief prose outside the region; a scratch probe proves sys.modules[__name__] is the very module pytest executes and that patching through it reaches module globals, so the round-1 duplicate-module hazard cannot recur. Fitness for purpose: with this frontend and the approved candidate published, a reader sees '3.895% October monthly (30-day) average EFFR' (Fed card) and '2.375% quarterly average CORRA' (BoC card) - correct tenor, correct label, level present, DOM-verified; no monthly-tenor number under a quarterly label and no level-less card can result from the frozen pairing. The two minors concern WHEN the new tests fire, not what they catch: (a) even when pinned, a candidate whose observable_proxy carries no finite tenor key skips both new tests (crafted variants exit 0; the Fed card then renders 'observable proxy level available' with nothing failing), and (b) nothing in the standing publish documents or CI forces the pinned run, so in the documented flow the new tests are inert and enforcement rests on the per-iteration review prompt. Concrete non-blocking follow-ups in operator_instructions; nothing in this review blocks merging the frontend change or publishing iteration-03.

findings.issue: Even with FED_BOC_RENDER_CANDIDATE set, a candidate whose observable_proxy carries no finite tenor key makes both new tests skip instead of fail: the key-convention test skips when the Fed proxy has neither implied_monthly_average_rate nor implied_quarterly_average_rate, and the card test skips when the Fed monthly level is absent or null. A candidate that violates the just-amended BACKEND_DATA_SPEC requirement ('include an observable_proxy object with ... a tenor-specific average-rate key') therefore exits the pinned acceptance run green (exit 0); if published, the Fed card renders 'observable proxy level available' with no level while no machine gate anywhere fails (structural gate and archiver contain no tenor-key check; CI is unpinned). Consequently the round-2 requirement 'a payload-level test that fails when the Fed proxy lacks implied_monthly_average_rate' holds only when the quarterly key is present. The original round-1 defect class (value present but stored under the quarterly key) IS still caught - this is the narrower no-key/null corner.

Observable proxy only ... observable proxy level available . source ...' with no '%' anywhere in the region (scratch dom-v1.html / dom-v3.html; variants r2-variants/*.json). No compensating check: grep 'implied_monthly|implied_quarterly' over scripts/ = 0 hits; archive_fed_boc.py:57 requires only that observable_proxy be a dict.

findings.issue: Nothing in the standing documents or CI forces the pinned run before publish, so the two new tests are inert in the documented flow: they skip (exit 0) unless FED_BOC_RENDER_CANDIDATE is set; AGENT.md's publish flow (structural_gate -> validate_pm_review -> archive -> verify_data_only_changes) never executes them; MACRO_DATA_OPERATIONS.md's documented test command runs only test_econ_render/test_fed_boc_archive/test_data_only_release; release-contract.yml CI runs the suite unpinned; and the review-procedure doc the ops manual links to (docs/fed-boc-pm-review.md) does not exist in the repo. Only the per-iteration review prompt (review/2026-09-29/iteration-03/pm-review-prompt.txt) instructed the reviewer to run the pinned form, so enforcement of the new candidate-acceptance gate depends on a fresh ad-hoc instruction each round rather than a documented step.

operator_instructions: Non-blocking follow-up 1 (test hardening, next natural rebuild): when FED_BOC_RENDER_CANDIDATE is set and the pinned candidate has a fed observable_proxy, a missing or non-finite implied_monthly_average_rate must FAIL rather than skip (same for boc implied_quarterly_average_rate); keep skip tolerance only for candidates without observable_proxy or for unpinned runs. This closes the V1/V2/V3 green-skip gap.

Non-blocking follow-up 2 (process wiring, next natural rebuild): require the pinned candidate run as an explicit step of candidate acceptance before archive/publish in fed-boc-watcher/AGENT.md and docs/MACRO_DATA_OPERATIONS.md (or add it to CI against the frozen candidate), so the gate cannot be skipped by omission; also fix the dangling docs/fed-boc-pm-review.md link (repoint to fed-boc-watcher/PM_REVIEW_GATE.md or restore the file).

Confirmation (no action): the frontend change and the approved iteration-03 candidate may merge/publish under this review - all round-1 findings are verified remediated; the two minors concern future gate activation, not the shipped rendering.
